structure: Part 7, Identification numbers and consignment contact. Read in full: the identification-numbers feature folder (page.js, evaluation.js, fields.js, controller.js, template.njk, copy.en.js, copy.cy.js and identification-numbers.fit.spec.js, 336 lines with 3 commodity-type branches x 5-6 tests plus 2 standalone tests); the consignment-contact-select feature folder (page.js, evaluation.js, fields.js, controller.js, template.njk, copy.en.js, copy.cy.js, view-model/index.js, view-model/pagination.js and consignment-contact-select.fit.spec.js, 514 lines, 20 tests in 5 describe blocks); journeys/linear/parties/index.js (the unresolved address-book reference sanitiser); obligations/sections/parties.js (consignor, supplierIdentificationNumber, producerIdentificationNumber, cropIdentificationNumber, consignmentNumber) and obligations/sections/contact.js (contactAddress); and the address-book-picker folder (address-lines.js, render.js, pagination.js, view-model.js) for context only, claimed here only as it shows on the contact page. Unit tests (*.test.js) are out of scope per the partition. Shared copy strings (Save and continue, Back, hub statuses, section caption) were looked up by key to quote what the fit specs assert. Pages covered: /notifications/{ref}/identification-numbers (Consignment parties section) and /notifications/{ref}/consignment/contact/select (Contact section).

claims.statement: Saved place-of-destination and consignor answers are references to address-book records, resolved from the book on every read, so a record the trader later corrects is corrected on the notification too.
claims.quote:
A reference is an `{ addressId }` and nothing more: the details are resolved
 * from the book on every read, so a record the trader later corrects is
 * corrected on the notification too.

claims.statement: When the address-book record behind a saved place of destination or consignor has been deleted (including soft-deleted), the answer is treated as never entered for display, completion and evaluation.
claims.quote:
A soft-deleted
 * record comes back with `deleted: true` and counts as gone — the UCD decision
 * to treat a deleted address as if it were never entered.

claims.statement: A dangling party reference is dropped only for the current request; the stored answer is cleared only when a later save rebuilds the answers, and the stored answer is kept beside the sanitised one so a page can tell 'answered, then deleted' from 'never answered'.
claims.quote:
Request-local. What was saved is left alone in the store — the next commit
 * that rebuilds from the current answers is what persists the clear — and the
 * engine keeps the stored answers beside the sanitised ones so a page can still
 * tell "answered, then deleted" from "never answered".

claims.statement: Party references are resolved against the signed-in user's organisation's address book.
claims.quote: const orgId = organisationIdOf(request)

The producer identification number obligation is mandatory and applies only when the commodity type is potatoes.

name: 'producerIdentificationNumber',
  status: 'mandatory',
  applyTo: equalsGate(

claims.statement: The consignment number obligation is optional and applies to every commodity type.

name: 'consignmentNumber',

claims.statement: The contact address obligation is mandatory and applies to every notification, yet the contact page allows a blank save; the mandatory status therefore bites at submission rather than on the page.
claims.quote:
name: 'contactAddress',
  status: 'mandatory'
claims.note: Inferred from a mandatory obligation with no applyTo gate beside a page that commits nothing on a blank save. What check answers or submit then does with a missing contact is in another part.

claims.statement: The four identification answers feed the supplierIdentificationNumber, producerIdentificationNumber, cropIdentificationNumber and consignmentNumber obligations, and the contact answer feeds the contactAddress obligation, which together drive the task rows' statuses.
claims.quote: scalar({ field: 'contactAddress', obligation: contactAddress })
claims.note: That the bindings drive the task row statuses is inferred from the fit specs' Completed, Optional and Not yet started statuses.

claims.statement: The consignment contact page uses only the organisation's address book: there is no option to enter a contact by hand or to add a new address from the page.
claims.note: Looked through the template, controller and copy: no manual-entry route, no 'add a new address' link and no link to the address book service. Whether one is wanted is not said here.

claims.statement: Nothing in this slice says how the saved consignment contact (a copy) is shown on check answers or what a contact whose source record was later deleted looks like there.
